observations.paraphrase: Seal6 cites Kjærum1994fig1726; seal7 cites fig1725 and Al-Sindi1999no279. Both are from Qala’at al-Bahrain. Seal13 instead cites Kjærum1983no279, Failaka. Table numbers apply only within this article.

Seven Gulf Type seals are assigned to Qala’at periodIIa, dated about2050–2000BCE; one possibly belongs toIb. Two have inscriptions and five do not. Stratigraphy cannot establish stylistic development withinIIa.
The author reports no sealings or other impressions associated with these early seals as then known.
Western sign-order differences, pseudo-inscription and prefixed human figures support the author's non-Harappan-language/name hypothesis; the paper does not supply a translation alignment.
